page_title: WOL 2-1 CHE | Wolves v Chelsea 24/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' David Coote is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+11' Having seen unsporting behavior, David Coote shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marcus Bettinelli (Chelsea) is the recipient.
90+10' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+10' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+9' David Coote has issued a yellow card to Raheem Sterling (Chelsea).
90+6' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) does well to meet a cross inside the box and produces a perfect header which goes low inside the left post.
90+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Matt Doherty (Wolves) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
90+2' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
90' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
87' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Wolves will take a corner kick.
87' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Rayan Ait Nouri and he is replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Matt Doherty (Wolves) for Matheus Cunha.
85' The cross into the penalty area from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
84' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
84' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes it short.
84' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
82' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
80' Substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) in, Nicolas Jackson out.
80' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) replaces Malo Gusto.
79' Substitution. Levi Colwill leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
78' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
77' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
76' Good chance for Matheus Cunha (Wolves) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the left post.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Sarabia.
75' David Coote blows his whistle and signals a foul after Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
74' A cross into the box from Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is cleared.
72' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

72' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is being substituted because of an injury. Gary O'Neil sends Santiago Bueno on the pitch.
66' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

66' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
65' It seemed like Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
64' A pass lands at the feet of Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
62' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
61' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee David Coote who sees an offensive foul.
60' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
59' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Armando Broja will be replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
59' Substitution. Lesley Ugochukwu makes his way off the pitch and Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
58' Lesley Ugochukwu (Chelsea) picks up an injury.
56' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will miss the next game.
56' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
55' Mario Lemina (Wolves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Djordje Petrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
54' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

51' 1 - 0 Mario Lemina (Wolves) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Pablo Sarabia. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
51' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
51' This shall not pass! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
49' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
49' Djordje Petrovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Toti (Wolves) after a cross from the side.
48' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
48' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

47' Joao Gomes (Wolves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
46' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45+1' Craig Dawson (Wolves) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
45+1' Joao Gomes (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just over the bar.
44' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
44' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
43' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
41' Craig Dawson (Wolves) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
41' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
41' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
40' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
38' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

34' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Jose Sa thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
32' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
31' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Wolves get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was quite harsh and David Coote didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' A decent effort by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
28' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
27' Mario Lemina (Wolves) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
25' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
24' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is penalised for holding. David Coote signals a set piece.
22' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
21' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
21' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nicolas Jackson, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
20' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
17' Poor challenge! Craig Dawson (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and David Coote blows his whistle.
14' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes a short corner kick.
14' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
13' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
13' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
12' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
12' That's unlucky! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
6' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
6' David Coote blows his whistle and it's Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Joao Gomes (Wolves) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
3' Rough tackle by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be David Coote.
